triggers.description: Bare Actuating implements, hands publication to Ship, and drives review to terminal closure.
Explicit modes select only implement, triage, remediation-plan, or review-closeout.
Unqualified review, inspect, audit, or classify intent is non-mutating triage.

routes.description: Select and realize the current correct-by-construction architecture.
Acquire review and classify Counterexamples without mutation.

Evaluate Counterexamples, realize a successor, ablate residue, normalize accumulated review paths, publish when required, and obtain fresh convergence.
Hand a current ready-to-ship proof to Ship and record returned publication evidence.
Apply the closure theorem to current artifacts and observations.
